notes.title: 0.1.20.6800 update
notes.notes:
1.Optimazed the operation on private safe.
2.Optimazed the feedback of items or equipments being corroded.
3.Updated the description of needles weapon’s passive ability.
4.Updated the feedback when buff status’s duration reduce.
5.Updated the access to monster log handbook in battle.
6.Updated helping info in setting options.
7.Display Crit and Dodge attributes in character menu.
8.Added a notification after being rescued.
9.Added a notification after certain level being unlocked.
10.The copied rescue code will be pasted into rescue ciphertext box automatically.
11.Updated the performance of weak status, its duration changed into 3 turns now.
12.The option give up and leave the ruins is changed into Commite suicide. And it is considered as failure.
13.Updated the description of characters of nematodes and ruin patrol.
14.Ruin labor’s passive ability is changed to costing stamina to restore health.
15.Updated the passive ability of Perlos. Instead of fear and fleet in the third round, it will fear at the end of second round and fleet in the third round.
16.The talent First Aid of S.O.R is changed. It will restore the health of character with lowest health propotionally.
17.Added a fleet option in battle. Now you can fleet in due course.
①Fleet successfully will share the same rule to winning the game. Except for you don’t gain the experience and your Fel increase by 50.
②You can’t fleet when your Fel is 100.
③You can’t fleet in tutorial, boss fight and rescue.
18.Fixed a problem that using bless or weapon prayer wouldn’t trigger the S.O.R talent Prayer Resonance.
19.Fixed a display problem that when monster is using AOE skills, the displayed targets were not wrong.
20.FIxed a display problem that when a character with holy shield status dies of DOT, its light effect won’t be removed correctly.
21.Fixed a bug that in Trial of Fantasy, the items’ name and effects are not changing randomly.
22.Fixed a bug that you can’t use Escape Arcana in battle of Endless Abyss of level 40 or higher.
23.Fixed a bug that under Enchantment bless status, your character can’t use Full Moon Potion or Purification Potion to enchant foes.
24.Fixed a problem that when equip a negative effected trinket in Trial of Fantasy and take it off, the negative effect still works.
25.Fixed a bug that S.O.R talent Initial Energy won’t work correctly in rescue dungeon.
26.Fixed a bug that some passvie ability of monsters summoned by Molingmose won’t work correctly.
27.Fixed a bug that some light effect renew mechanic of stun or other negative status isn’t working properly.
28.Fixed a bug that if the player quit the game when in dungeon, the statistic data won’t be saved properly.
29.Fixed a bug that the player can’t click the button of quick access to rescue in windowed mode.
30.Fixed a bug that switch equipment when removing its special ability will cause its default ability being removed as well.
31.Fixed a problem that merged trinket’s name wouldn’t appear blue.
32.Fixed the preview displaying mistake of strengthening equipments.
33.Fixed a bug that used items’ name in Trial of Fantasy won’t display correctly and remain unidentified.
34.Fixed a bug that if the player switches character panel when the character is wearing blessed equipments, then all equiped equipments would appear in golden font.
35.Fixed a bug that the data collected by S.O.R appears error and it will constantly notify new module unlocked when leaving dungeon.
36.Fixed the problem that 9 new monsters lack sound effect when casting skills.
37.Fixed the incompleted description of special skills in character attribute panel.
38.Fixed a bug that the certain achievement will be unlocked even its object of finishing level 99 is not achieved.
39.Fixed a bug that tomb would appear in Endless Abyss dungeon.
40.Fixed a bug that players can use Returning Home Prayer or call for rescue to repeatedly gain Crowd.
41.Fixed a bug that Time Altar isn’t working properly.
42.Fixed a bug that if re-enter Glazed Ruin after finishing it, the final boss won’t appear properly.
43.Fixed a bug that rescue in Glazed Ruin would encounter boss fight.
44.Fixed a bug that mouseovering items’ tip info when the item panel is rolled up, some info text might be blocked.

notes.title: version 0.1.19.6700
notes.notes:
1. New quick access for rescue. You can now start your rescue from higher level to save time.
2. Bonus gold reward added to final rescue reward.
3. New dungeon Glazed Ruin. Unlocked by completing Endless Abyss.
①9 new monsters awaiting your challenge in Glazed Ruin! Slay them all!
②New equipments with special effect added! YOu can loot them from Bosses in level 33, 66 and 99 of Glazed Ruin.
③New potions and items added! They can be obtained in Glazed Ruin. Use them to challenge new dungeon.
④3 new challenging achievements added! 
4. Fixed a bug that any change you did to Bank - Private safe wouldn't be saved.
5. Fixed a bug that the game would frequently tip that "Not a skill selection phase!" during combat.
6. FIxed a bug that when a character with weak curse state kills the last monster and triumph, his/her curse's duration wouldn't reduce.

notes.title: version 0.1.18.6600
notes.notes:
1. Update the unlock of Trial of Fantasy to finish 4th chapter.
2. Poison and damage deepening's duration decrease to 5 turns.
3. Alert monsters appear rate decrease.
4. Trap of story mode's type and appear rate decrease.
5. Updated the loot of story mode.
6. Gulkin's skill updates.
Savege collision: Hit the target and damage a whole row, confuse any missed target.
Shadow scare: Decrease the dagmage that teammate hebind takes.
7. Peleus's skill updates.
Aid: restores minor health for teammates.
God's hand: remove a random debuff of a teammate at the end of each turn.
8. New function for repairing bad saves.
9. New mod!
10. Abomination and Molingmose can no longer use skills without mana.
11. Fixed a bug that Prophet's Golden Sword has no special effect.
12. Fixed a bug that when a hero's down, it may stand up again when monster uses AOE.
13. Fixed a bug that bleeding debuff won't be removed correctly after healing events.
14. Optimised performance.

notes.title: version 0.1.16.6400
notes.notes:
1. [Ruins Merchant's products are too expensive for you? Rob'em, rob'em all!]
Now you can rob Ruins Merchants in shopping menu by clicking [?] button. You can loot them by defeating them. (Merchants from Endless Abyss will have extra [S]loot.)
2. [New service offered by Seggie squad! Have you lost your valuable equipments? Don't worry, new retrieval service is for you!]
At a cost of some gold, you can ask Seggie to retrieve all equipments of your heroes (not ones in your backpack). It costs more as your heroes have died deeper.
3. [Share all achievments of your savings in one account! Don't bother to hunt for achievement for your different savings!}
4. Fixed a bug that when you use Escape Arcana, your heroes' buffs won't be removed correctly.
5. Fixed a bug that your heroes have died, their DOT debuffs won't be removed correctly.

notes.title: version 0.1.16.6400
notes.notes:
1. [Ruins Merchant's products are too expensive for you? Rob'em, rob'em all!]
Now you can rob Ruins Merchants in shopping menu by clicking [?] button. You can loot them by defeating them. (Merchants from Endless Abyss will have extra [S]loot.)
2. [New service offered by Seggie squad! Have you lost your valuable equipments? Don't worry, new retrieval service is for you!]
At a cost of some gold, you can ask Seggie to retrieve all equipments of your heroes (not ones in your backpack). It costs more as your heroes have died deeper.
3. [Share all achievments of your savings in one account! Don't bother to hunt for achievement for your different savings!}
4. Fixed a bug that when you use Escape Arcana, your heroes' buffs won't be removed correctly.
5. Fixed a bug that your heroes have died, their DOT debuffs won't be removed correctly.

notes.title: version 0.1.15.6300
notes.notes:
1. You can retrieve your Crown now. If you lost your Crown, you can retrieve it from Seggie for some coins.
2. Buff the effect of blessing on weapons/armors. Now the item blessed will be enhanced by 15%. The blessing effect on weapon has a 15% chance to be removed when hitting enemies, while the blessing effect on armor has a 15% chance to be removed when getting hit.
3. Added an option to choose language when launching the game.
4. Optimized the experience when trying to loot with full inventory.
5. Optimized the animation when opening the cursed chest.
6. Fixed the bug that Ruins Gunners use items twice in the first round.
7. Fixed the bug that Perlos fleet in the wrong timing. The correct timing should be in the third round.
8. Fixed the bug that Beatles have no passive buff in the beginning of the combat.
9. Fixed the bug that Infected Labors cannot do any damage to heroes.
10. FIxed the bug that heroes don't gain the immunity to according debuff when recover from stun/sleep.

notes.title: 0.1.14.6200 Update
notes.notes:
1.Optimize the animation of triggering skill altars.
2.Fix the error that the buff icon added by star altar can be removed by Full Moon Potion.  
3.Fix the error that the buff from Cursed buff remains effective even after its duration runs out.
4.Fix the bug that when critical hit the enemies of instigation state, the effect of Scare Talisman would occur upon team members.
5.Change the effect of Staunch crystal to "Keep 1 hp when receive fatal damage."
6.Change the effect of Immortal Altar to "Revive if every unit has finished one round and at least one party member survive." And increase its probability of occurrence.
7.Change the duration mechanics of buff and debuff. Now the duration of buff and debuff will be counted only by its duration of rounds, rather than by actions. 
8.Change the self-healing mechanics of Elite Ruins labors. Now it only triggers once per round.
9.Change the mechanics of multiple action, now the hero can have more action right after taking potion that allowing more actions per round.
10.Change the mechanics of DOT. Now DOT only causes damage at the end of each round, rather than at the end of each action.
11.Other optimization.
